plane_energy_census.registered_reading_of_that_table: OVER THE 264-TOKEN SEALED SEQUENCE THE DOMINANT PLANES BARELY ROTATE.  Plane 21 carries 0.3107 of the score energy and traverses 0.0304 radians across a whole sequence; planes 24 and above traverse less than 0.01 radians and are position-independent for every purpose this evidence can see.  So the parent's attention on this evidence is dominated by a near-DC CONTENT term carried in low-frequency RoPE planes, and the genuinely positional planes (p <= 8, phase > 8 radians) carry 0.2469 of the energy -- which is EXACTLY the band wave 15's HD16 kept, and HD16 read 0/15.  This is registered as the mechanism attribution BEFORE the build, which is what the slate asked for.

band_slide_is_load_bearing_at_d32_and_no.registered_consequence: at d=48 the default window already contains all four dominant planes and every slide is worse, so the NEW knob buys nothing at the rung this wave builds.  At d=32 the best expressible band retains 2.31x what the default band retains AT BYTE-IDENTICAL STORAGE, which is slate section 4 lever 3's first quantitative support and is registered here so that a later wave cannot claim it was obvious.

cells.registered_deviation: THE SLATE SAYS 'a plain normal-equation ridge in d unknowns per layer against cached pre-softmax logits', SINGULAR.  The logit is BILINEAR in the two gain vectors, so a single joint solve is not a plain normal equation.  This build runs ONE such ridge on the q side and then ONE on the k side with the other held fixed.  The stop is one pass per side and NOT an alternation loop.  Registered before the build.
